etymologies.etymologyHTML: From enhance +‎ -ment.

definitions.definition: An improvement or supplement that tends to increase a sense of esteem.

quote.citation: 2021 July 14, “Modern Images”, in RAIL, number 935, page 37, photo caption:
quote.text: Dawn mist rolling off the adjacent North Downs creates a sepia effect over the river with no need for digital enhancement.

definitions.definition: (radiology) The degree to which the image of a scan stands out as a bright area.

quote.citation: 2016, Nuzhat A. Ahmad, Management of Pancreatic Diseases:
quote.text: The enhancement characteristics of a PNET on CT may also have prognostic value, as lesions that hypoenhance on CT scan tend to have worse overall survival than lesions that are isoenhancing or hyperenhancing (5-year survival 54% vs 89% vs 93%).
